categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Sepax Technologies Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main business segments: analytical chromatography and industrial purification. The company develops, manufactures, and sells chromatography columns and chromatographic media used in drug analysis, quality control, and large-scale purification processes, serving the entire drug development lifecycle from research to commercial production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses advanced core technologies including microsphere synthesis, surface modification, and functionalization techniques for chromatographic media. It has developed proprietary seed swelling polymerization methods, surface nano-coating technologies, and grafting reaction modification to produce high-performance chromatographic materials. Additionally, it has pioneered shell-core composite chromatographic media technology, enabling multi-mode separation capabilities, and maintains strict quality control and production processes certified by ISO9001 and ICH GMP guidelines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sepax Technologies serves global biopharmaceutical companies, including major international pharmaceutical and biotech firms such as Roche, Pfizer, Eli Lilly, Moderna, and Regeneron, as well as leading domestic Chinese pharmaceutical enterprises. Its products are applied in antibody drugs, insulin/peptides/GLP-1, recombinant proteins, vaccines, nucleic acid drugs, and other biopharmaceutical sectors, supporting drug R&D, clinical trials, and commercial manufacturing.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Suzhou and manufacturing facilities in Suzhou and Yangzhou. It also has subsidiaries in the United States responsible for R&D, production, and sales targeting North American and international markets. The company has expanded its global footprint to Europe, Australia, South America, India, Korea, and Russia, serving customers worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sepax Technologies operates mainly in the midstream segment of the biopharmaceutical supply chain, producing critical chromatographic consumables and media used in downstream drug purification and analysis. It provides key materials and technical services essential for drug development, clinical testing, and commercial production phases.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-performance chromatographic materials, focusing on enhancing microsphere synthesis, surface and functional group modifications, and developing new chromatographic media such as high-load, alkali-resistant Protein A affinity media and shell-core composite media. It invests significantly in R&D to support emerging biopharmaceutical modalities like ADCs, mRNA, gene therapy vectors, and complex biologics, aiming to lead in domestic substitution of imported products and expand global market share.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of chromatography columns, chromatographic media (fillers), and related technical services. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by distributors domestically and internationally, with customized product development and technical support enhancing customer retention and recurring sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sepax Technologies competes with global leaders such as Thermo Fisher, Cytiva (GE Healthcare Life Sciences), Merck KGaA, Tosoh, and Agilent. It is recognized as a leading domestic player with growing market share in China, particularly in industrial purification media, and is expanding its presence internationally. The company is noted for its advanced technology platforms and increasing success in replacing imported products in the Chinese biopharmaceutical market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 315.46 million, representing a 28.65% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 85.16 million, up 62.25%, with a net profit margin improvement driven by scale and operational efficiencies. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio (~13.59% of revenue) and has expanded production capacity, including ongoing construction of a second phase Yangzhou facility to increase annual chromatographic media output significantly.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sepax Technologies emphasizes its comprehensive core technology platforms enabling precise control over microsphere size, pore structure, and surface chemistry, resulting in chromatographic media with superior stability, high binding capacity, and low nonspecific adsorption. Its products cover a broad range of separation modes and are tailored to complex biopharmaceutical molecules, offering customers reliable, high-quality, and cost-effective alternatives to imported products. The company’s strong technical support, customization capabilities, and global service network further differentiate it as a trusted partner in the biopharmaceutical industry.
